messages:
Zoe: Weird morning: found a Post-it on Conference 2B that says 'DO NOT FOLD ME' with an arrow pointing to the corner. Who's crafting cryptic office poetry now?
Marcus: guilty. I was testing a new low-effort treasure-hunt mechanic for onboarding. Did not expect it to become performance art.
Elena: It led me on a 4-minute odyssey that ended with a stapler wearing a tiny hat. 10/10 experience.
Priya: Wait the stapler hat is a thing now? Please confirm: is this the same stapler that jammed during Q3 OKR review?
Marcus: same ancient stapler. I crowned it to appease the paper gods.
SnackBot: Poll created: "Stapler crown material"  React with :one: (post-it), :two: (aluminum foil), :three: (mint tin). Free cookies to voters.
Zoe: Evidence log: found coordinates written on a sticky: `x=2.3, y=5.1 ~look behind the fern`. I did and found a tiny origami swan named 'Mildly Suspicious'.
Elena: mild_suspicious_swans.png incoming to #random-pics.
Marcus: sorry for any chaos. The goal was to give new hires an excuse to wander and meet people. Turns out it also confuses bots.
CleanerBot: Alert: detected small paper constructions left on conference table at 08:17. Scheduled pickup for 09:00 to avoid clogging vacuum.
Priya: Also discovered a Post-it chain that read like a choose-your-own-adventure: 
```
Start -> Go to kitchen -> Find kettle -> Turn left -> Stand on one leg -> Receive a cookie
```
Zoe: I tried the one-leg bit. Got a cookie and weird looks from legal. Worth it.
Elena: Suggest we codify this as an official ritual: Monthly Post-it Pilgrimage. Benefits: morale + cardio.
Marcus: I can write a tiny rulebook. Rule 1: Do not put sticky trails across emergency exits.
SnackBot: Reminder: cookies for pilgrims will be in kitchen at 11:30. Please compost used sticky notes in the blue bin.
Zoe: @Marcus can we get a leaderboard for Pilgrimage points? I demand recognition for my dramatic one-leg salute.
Marcus: yes. Categories: Explorer, Curator of Oddities, and Grand Tactician (for elaborate multi-floor clues). Prize: enamel pin and eternal bragging rights.
Priya: Proposal: next time use a riddle about the ficus so Shade gets involved. (Shade must be consulted for all light-based clues.)
CleanerBot: Friendly reminder: do not leave glitter or confetti. Vacuum compatibility level: 3/10.
Elena: Duly noted. No glitter. Marcus: less glitter, more tasteful stapler hats.
Marcus: Deal. Also, to the new hires: consider the Post-it trail your official unofficial welcome. Say hi when you get a cookie.
Zoe: Mystery solved-ish. Whoever made the 'DO NOT FOLD ME' sticky: top-tier sass. We salute you.
SnackBot: Poll results in 20 minutes. Cookies reserved for voters.
